ITEM TEXT
Charlie Chaplin
and
his
brother
Sydney
were
placed
in
an
orphanage
at
a
very
early
age
.
Becoming
a
vaudeville
performer
,
he
joined
Fred Karno's
company
in
1906
.
He
made
his
film
debut
in
Making a Living
,
1914
and
introduced
the
famous
seedy
and
soft-hearted
gentleman-tramp
routine
,
which
became
his
hallmark
.
Numerous
films
for
various
studios
brought
him
world
fame
,
all
based
on
his
mastery
of
pathos
and
slapstick
acrobatics
.
